title: Hardwiring left inputs
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $m+n$ input vertices, and let $y$ be a Boolean assignment to the first $m$ inputs. Form a circuit with $n$ input vertices by placing, before the gates of $C$, one constant gate for each value of $y$, in order. Remap every argument index of the original gates and the output index by sending $v$ to $n+v$ for $v<m$, to $v-m$ for $m\le v<m+n$, and to $v$ for $v\ge m+n$.
